front.title: Causal Provenance Receipts for Agent Sessions: A SCITT Profile

abstract.t: This document defines a Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust (SCITT) payload profile for agent session provenance: signed records that bind an autonomous agent session's lifecycle (start, governed tool dispatch, state transitions, termination, and settlement) to offline-verifiable cryptographic evidence, with an explicit head commitment that detects local hash-chain truncation and whole-store rollback. It reuses the SCITT architecture and COSE receipt envelope: the Causal Provenance Receipt (CPR) bundle is the signed statement payload, and registration with a Transparency Service is optional and explicitly disclosed. This profile addresses the session-lifecycle and resumption-evidence grain rather than isolated per-action telemetry, while preserving bounded verifier semantics: a verifier checks cryptographic signatures, canonical digests, chain links, and external anchors; it does not prove that unallegeable physical events occurred.
